components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(0 0% 98%); color: hsl(240 5% 10%); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(0 0% 98% / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 80%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline/Ghost Button
components.description: Default toolbar action (Copy Image, Clear, Sample Log, icon buttons).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: hsl(0 0% 95%); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 16%); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(240 4% 18%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 80%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: The Preview and Input panel shell: three horizontal bands (toolbar / content / footer).
components.css: .ds-card { background: hsl(240 5% 10%); color: hsl(0 0% 95%); border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 16%); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-band { background: hsl(240 4% 15% / 0.4); padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-card-content { padding: 1rem; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field, e.g. the character-name input.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; color: hsl(0 0% 95%); border: 1px solid hsl(240 4% 16%); border-radius: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px hsl(240 4% 80%); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(240 4% 60% / 0.6); }

components.name: Chat Line
components.description: Signature component: authentic in-game chat text, multi-span colored per matched rule.
components.html: [INFO] Dispatch reported a suspicious vehicle.
components.css: .ds-chatline { -webkit-font-smoothing: none; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0; line-height: 1.32; word-break: break-word; text-shadow: -1px -1px 0 #000, 1px -1px 0 #000, -1px 1px 0 #000, 1px 1px 0 #000; font-size: 15px; }

narrative.overview: The app is deliberately two visual worlds sharing one screen. The tool chrome — cards, toolbars, buttons, sliders — is a quiet, dark-first, near-monochrome utility surface built from a standard shadcn/Radix component set on tight HSL neutrals. It has almost no personality of its own on purpose: its job is to disappear so the second world reads clearly. The second world is the chat canvas itself: bold, saturated, high-contrast text reproducing GTA World's actual in-game chat colors and rendering quirks. This is the product's real payload, and it is intentionally exempt from the app's own design-token discipline.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-mode-first neutral shell with light mode as a fully supported secondary variant.
Two independent color systems: app chrome tokens vs. the in-game chat palette.
Three-band card composition (toolbar / content / footer) repeated across every panel.
Minimal elevation — borders and muted-background strips do the separating work, not shadows.

rules.name: The Two-Palette Rule
rules.body: Chrome colors and chat colors never cross. Chrome always resolves through globals.css HSL variables; chat text always resolves through chat-colors.ts hex values.

rules.name: The Outline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: The chat line's text-shadow is a hard 1px outline in four cardinal directions, not a soft drop shadow. Never soften it into a blur.

rules.name: The Band-Not-Box Rule
rules.body: Structure within a panel is shown by alternating background wash and hairline borders between horizontal bands, never by nesting additional bordered/shadowed boxes inside a card.

dos: Do keep chat-line colors resolving only through chat-colors.ts, regardless of the active app theme.
Do build any new panel from the toolbar/content/footer three-band pattern already used by Preview and Input.
Do pair every icon-only control with both an aria-label and a Tooltip.
Do use rounded-full exclusively for color-swatch/selector affordances, never for general buttons.
donts: Don't apply /70-/80 opacity modifiers to text-muted-foreground for body copy.
Don't size interactive controls below 24x24px; treat 44x44px as the real target on touch.
Don't introduce hardcoded Tailwind palette colors outside small inline icon accents.
Don't let the chat canvas inherit theme-aware styling.
